title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame 'experiments' contains two columns: 'Antibiotic' and 'Colonies'. The 'Antibiotic' column represents the amount of antibiotic added, and the 'Colonies' column shows the number of bacterial colonies after $$12$$ hours.

title: Choosing the Correct Column for x-axis
text: For the x-axis of the scatterplot, you need to choose the column that represents the independent variable. In this case, it's the amount of antibiotic added.
